calls.statement:
WITH active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
),
ver AS (
    SELECT a.member_id, count(*) AS n_ver, min(cur.tier) AS tier
    FROM active a JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id
      AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
    GROUP BY a.member_id
)
SELECT 'active' AS k, count(*) AS n, NULL AS tier FROM active
UNION ALL SELECT 'with_version', count(*), NULL FROM ver
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_version', count(*), NULL FROM ver WHERE n_ver > 1
UNION ALL SELECT 'tier', count(*), tier FROM ver GROUP BY tier
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_member_key_join_miss', count(*), NULL FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_key=f.member_key)

calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.channel_code, s.store_id, p.category, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.quantity, f.net_amount, w.status, m.join_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
),
per AS (
    SELECT member_id,
      max(CASE WHEN store_id <> 999 AND category <> 'ZZ Test' AND coalesce(status,'x') <> 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clean,
      max(CASE WHEN store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999,
      max(CASE WHEN category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zz,
      max(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canc,
      max(CASE WHEN quantity <= 0 OR net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos,
      max(CASE WHEN sale_date < join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS before_join
    FROM lines GROUP BY member_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS members, sum(clean) AS clean_members, sum(s999) AS any_999, sum(zz) AS any_zz, sum(canc) AS any_cancelled, sum(nonpos) AS any_nonpos, sum(before_join) AS before_join,
  sum(CASE WHEN clean=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_nonclean
FROM per

calls.statement:
WITH as_of AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_end_date AS as_of_end
    FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
    WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 8
),
active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    CROSS JOIN as_of
    WHERE f.sale_date > as_of.as_of_end - 364
      AND f.sale_date <= as_of.as_of_end
)
SELECT as_of.fiscal_year, as_of.fiscal_period, cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members
FROM active a
CROSS JOIN as_of
JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id
                   AND as_of.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
GROUP BY as_of.fiscal_year, as_of.fiscal_period, cur.tier
ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 3 END
